# Developer webhook events

Every webhook is an immutable projection of a tenant-scoped domain event. Event payloads use the versioned JSON Schemas listed below; money, prices, and quantities are decimal strings, never JSON floating-point numbers.

Unknown event types, source mismatches, and payloads that fail their schema are not delivered. Subscribe only to event types returned by the authenticated `GET /developer/event-types` catalog.

Catalog entries: 36. Schema entries: 36.

### fee.accrued (v1)

A fee accrual was persisted from an authoritative fee source. Monetary values are exact decimal strings.

Schema URI: `urn:wlct:event-schema:fee.accrued:v1`.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:wlct:event-schema:fee.accrued:v1",
  "title": "fee.accrued v1 payload",
  "description": "A fee accrual was persisted from an authoritative fee source. Monetary values are exact decimal strings.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "accrualId",
    "sourceType",
    "sourceId",
    "feeType",
    "grossAmount",
    "feeAmount",
    "currency",
    "feeRateBps",
    "status"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "accrualId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 255
    },
    "sourceType": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 64
    },
    "sourceId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 255
    },
    "feeType": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 64
    },
    "grossAmount": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\.[0-9]+)?$",
      "maxLength": 64
    },
    "feeAmount": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\.[0-9]+)?$",
      "maxLength": 64
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$",
      "maxLength": 12
    },

  "title": "risk.stop_triggered v1 payload",
  "description": "A persisted unified risk decision required an immediate stop. This event does not itself release or bypass a kill switch.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "decisionId",
    "ruleIds",
    "policyVersion",
    "scope",
    "scopeId",
    "severity",
    "triggeredAt"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "decisionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 255
    },
    "ruleIds": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 100,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 64
      }
    },
    "policyVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 96
    },
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "PLATFORM",
        "TENANT",
        "TRADER",
        "STRATEGY",
        "FOLLOWER"
      ]
    },
    "scopeId": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "maxLength": 255
    },
    "severity": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "INFO",
        "WARNING",
        "CRITICAL",
        "EMERGENCY"
      ]
    },
    "triggeredAt": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time",
      "maxLength": 64
    }
  },
  "examples": [
    {
      "decisionId": "risk-decision-example",
      "ruleIds": [
        "DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT"
      ],
      "policyVersion": "policy-v1",
      "scope": "TENANT",
      "scopeId": "tenant-example",
      "severity": "CRITICAL",
      "triggeredAt": "2026-10-09T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### withdrawal.confirmed (v1)

A withdrawal request was confirmed.

Schema URI: `urn:wlct:event-schema:withdrawal.confirmed:v1`.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "urn:wlct:event-schema:withdrawal.confirmed:v1",
  "title": "withdrawal.confirmed v1 payload",
  "description": "A withdrawal request was confirmed.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "withdrawalRequestId",
    "amount",
    "currency",
    "status"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "withdrawalRequestId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 255
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\.[0-9]+)?$",
      "maxLength": 64
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$",
      "maxLength": 12
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 64
    }
  },
  "examples": [
    {
      "withdrawalRequestId": "withdrawalRequestId-example",
      "amount": "100.00",
      "currency": "USD",
      "status": "CONFIRMED"
    }
  ]
}
```
